parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A cell of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $1.8\text{ V}$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected in parallel with a resistor of resistance $6.0\Omega$ and a filament lamp, as shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1.png}}

Fig. 7.1

The switch $S$ is open. The ammeter reading is $0.25\text{ A}$.

Determine the internal resistance $r$ of the cell.

parts.label: (c)
(c)(i)
parts.text: State whether the e.m.f. of the cell after $t_1$ is greater than, less than or the same as it was before $t_1$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: By considering the effect of the lamp on the total resistance of the circuit, explain the variation of the ammeter reading shown in Fig. 7.2.
